purpose: Exact contract that a future parameter freeze must satisfy; this artifact does not select, change, activate or deploy parameters.

required_authority.parameter_selection_authority: explicit Waterfound authority required after evidence gates close
required_authority.activation_authority: separate explicit authority required; never implied by freeze

immutable_bindings_required: DAA family and every DAA/timestamp parameter
initial launch target and calibration-evidence digest
coinbase maturity predicate and block count
capacity policy including max tx/block or equivalent

mandatory_fair_launch_invariants.inherited_testnet_balances: forbidden unless separately and explicitly authorized; current candidate model is fresh genesis

arithmetic_checks: Recompute terminal issuance from integer atom subsidies; never use reward*era*2 as a substitute.
Record exact shortfall; no implicit terminal top-up.
Assert all amounts fit canonical integer storage and serialization.
Recompute wall-clock halving and maturity from frozen block interval.
evidence_gates_required: DP6 specialized-advantage premise gate where economics depends on commodity participation
independent Project Assurance over the complete freeze bundle
fail_closed_rules: RESEARCH_CANDIDATE or PREFERRED_RESEARCH_INCUMBENT is not selection authority.
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE may not be converted into a winner.
Selection, freeze, release and activation are distinct authority transitions.
If any required evidence digest/source revision is missing or mismatched, freeze is invalid.
